attempts.summary: Created a self-signed local CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (4096-bit RSA, 10-year validity, CN=OS Comparison Root CA), installed it into the system trust store via update-ca-trust, verified it functions as a trusted CA (a leaf cert signed by it verifies against the system bundle), then performed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, triggered systemctl reboot, confirmed the node went unreachable then came back with a new boot_id, and re-verified the CA trust anchor and functional verification survived the restart.
